methods_group_definition_fragment.raw_text:
Based on amyloid 
and tau PET status, we generated four different biomarker groups: 
A−T−; A+T−; A+TMTL
+ (defined as tau PET-positive in the MTL but not in the 
neocortex); and A+TNEO-T
+ (defined as tau PET-positive in the NEO-T and/
or MTL; 49 out of 65 were also TMTL
+). The A−T+ group was considerably 
smaller than the other groups (n = 34; Extended Data Table 1), hence 
their results are only reported in Extended Data Fig. 1.
